# Security

## How to report a problem

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.

Report it in private: open the [Security tab](https://github.com/RunIO-dev/runio-script-ui/security) of this repository and choose "Report a vulnerability". Say which version you use, what an attacker can do, and how to reproduce it.

A fix comes out as a new version. The changelog names the problem once the fix is out.

## Which versions get fixes

The latest release. Before version 1.0 an older version gets no fix of its own.

## What the library protects, and what stays your job

The readme lists both under [What the library does for safety](../README.md#what-the-library-does-for-safety).
